text:
elaine: FYI PR #842 has a mismatch in the API ref for /v1/generate — docs show `input` but server expects `prompt` and `max_new_tokens` instead of `max_tokens`. Can someone fix examples + SDK snippets?

mike: thanks, noticing tests failing in docs CI. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

julia: I can update the REST examples and the python snippet. Do we want to preserve old `max_tokens` alias in examples for backwards compat? @sam?

sam: I'd rather update examples to canonical names (`prompt`, `max_new_tokens`) and add a migration note. We shouldn't encourage the alias. :+1:

mike: ok. I'll patch curl and JS snippets, julia can do python, elaine can add the migration note and changelog entry.

julia: quick python snippet draft:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
res = client.generate(model=\"redwood-2\", prompt=\"Summarize...\", max_new_tokens=64)
print(res.text)
```

mike: JS snippet done in the PR. Also CI flagged the example schema test failing: `examples/schema-check` — the request sample still had `input: null`. I'll push a fix for that test.

elaine: for the migration note, I'll add this under docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md with a short example and mention the new `max_new_tokens` rename and that server will accept `max_tokens` for 30 days.

sam: Also add a unit to the API ref page showing both request/response shapes side-by-side. Small table is fine.

julia: pushed python update in comment; requesting review from @mike and @elaine.

docs-bot: CI passed for branch update/fix-docs-generate-params (checks: schema-check, lint)

mike: approve once CI green. I'll merge after changelog entry.

elaine: thanks all. I'll handle the changelog and the short rollback plan.
